chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch.526: Han Li's Post-Battle Loot Analysis & Spirit Ginseng Setup
chapter_meta_description: Han Li investigates the five-colored beads from Extreme Xuan's bones, tests them on dying Golden Silk Silkworms, and secures his legendary Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng.
og_description: No battles. Just good old-fashioned xianxia resource management. Han Li tests his new theories with a dangerous cocktail of pills and bugs.
twitter_description: Testing five-colored beads on dying silkworms, securing a legendary ginseng – the paranoia never ends!

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary pill from the Void Heaven Cauldron, rumored to be able to repair or recreate a cultivator's Spiritual Roots. Han Li theorizes its true form is a recondensed bead.
A low-ranked spirit insect on the Strange Insect List. Known for its unique potential to evolve into a much more powerful form, the Flame Mirage Moth.
A high-ranking (17th) spirit insect on the Strange Insect List, possessing an innate ability of powerful illusion and transformation.
An ancient and authoritative ranking of spirit insects in the cultivation world, used by cultivators to assess the value and danger of a rare bug.
A legendary, highly intelligent spirit herb capable of forming incarnations and teleporting. A key ingredient for forming a Nascent Soul.
One of the legendary Three Great Spirit Trees. Its wood is used to nourish and preserve a cultivator's soul.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the "quiet victory" phase in the Mortal Stream?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's the crucial aftermath after a major conflict where the protagonist doesn't celebrate but instead meticulously audits his loot, sets up future projects, and plans his next move, emphasizing that survival is a long-term logistical war.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Han Li just eat the five-colored beads?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Even though he suspects they are the true Heaven-Mending Pill, he is a hyper-cautious survivor. He would rather test a highly suspicious, unknown substance on some dying bugs than risk his own cultivation base.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Ghost Yaksha (鬼夜叉)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a specific classification of undead monster. Unlike common ghosts, it possesses a physical body covered in green fur and can even move around in broad daylight.
